name: Disney+ (independent agent)
description: Disney+ subtitles through an independent private agent. Optional bounded wait during search; no Jellyfin plugin required.

agent_url.title: Disney+ agent URL
agent_url.description: Private Docker URL reachable from Bazarr+ (e.g. http://disney-agent:8787)

series_json.title: Series map (TVDB to Disney+ URL and episode mappings)

enable_requests.title: Queue new extractions during search
enable_requests.description: Opt-in: queue at most one extraction per search and wait for a ready SRT. Applies to manual AND scheduled searches; keep scheduled searches disabled until intentionally enabled.

wait_seconds.title: Wait for extraction (seconds)
wait_seconds.description: 0 returns immediately. Default 75, maximum 90. If still pending, search again later; polling does not enqueue more work. Provider Hub worker timeout must be at least 120 seconds.
